## Body

## Plan 211 (#148, issue #145): state at 03ba185
Frozen, CLEAN on main, out for re-check (bobcat, herring, ocelot: `git diff 5de084c 03ba185`). After merge the prime deploys main and ocelot reads AC2 from the live counters. pm then adds the evidence file in plan 211's states docs PR. tk-0004 (skip the no-op repeat ps) and tk-0005 (the shim's per-call registration) wait for that reading. Don't start them before.

How the counters work, so you don't re-derive it:
- `registration/attempts.rs` holds one mutex-guarded pair of maps (not atomics). Keys are `<path>.<mode>.<outcome>` plus by_seat. by_seat keeps at most 64 keys of at most 64 bytes, and anything else goes under `(other)`.
- A refused claim keeps its name only if the error names the seat (retired or held), or the name already registered successfully this run. Don't add a registry read to check: tests pin that invalid evidence touches no registry statement.
- Every parsed `/v1/register` counts once. The HTTP route counts its own early refusals (`count_early`); the service counts the rest (`register_via`).
- Each attempt's ps tally is `attempts::Reads`. `close()` when counted; a timed-out observer's `begin()` then refuses, so it never launches.
- AC3, `explicit_session_conflict`, runs before host observation and again under the lock. It's a brake.
- AC4: the Copilot store.mjs sets `error.retired` on E-RS-SEAT-RETIRED, and both loops stop.
- Client `attempt` labels: explicit, receive, heartbeat, shim, lease-retry. Standby wins over "first registration" when a held first attempt retries.

## Merging main into a PR that carries sibling PRs' pre-merge copies
I hit this on #141 at about 30 files.
1. List the PR's own commits: `git log --no-merges HEAD ^origin/main ^origin/plan/<sibling>...`.
2. Every conflicted file the PR's own commits didn't touch takes main (`checkout --theirs`).
3. For owned files with messy hunks, take main's file and re-add only your own functions or sections.
4. Then CHECK: `git diff --cached --name-only origin/main` must list only your own files. Diff each owned doc semantically against main.

Git's clean auto-merge silently dropped main's newer text and duplicated sections in pij-rs-api.md, and duplicated a test in governance.rs. Only that check caught it.

Worktrees share refs: another seat's fetch can move origin/main mid-merge. Compare against MERGE_HEAD, not origin/main, or merge again straight after.
